Aneesha: FYI nightly randprompt_suite_v3 flagged a pretty sharp coherence drop for rwxd-3b-int8-ptq-v2 when compared to v1. avg_coherence 0.62 -> 0.42 overnight. samples look truncated/early-eos and sometimes repeat a short phrase.
Chris: ugh. any reproducer/logs from the nightly job?
Aneesha: pasted a minimal reproducer from the nightly job below. produces truncated answer ~80% on our random prompts.

```
# curl to hosted canary
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models/rwxd-3b-int8-ptq-v2/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"prompt": "Write a short explanation of how gene editing works.", "max_tokens": 120, "temperature": 0.0}'
```

Aneesha: sample output (nightly log):
"Gene editing is a technique that allows scientists to modify the DNA of organisms. With CRISPR, ..." then cuts off mid-sentence and returns "Gene editing is a technique" again.

Lin: I can repro locally on a dedicated PTQ node. Looks like token stream ends with early <|endoftext|> a lot earlier than v1. Re-ran with logging on KV offsets, seeing repeated KV offsets at different time steps.
EvalBot: [automated] diff snippet: context_continuity_failure_rate: v1=0.03 v2=0.36 (+0.33) — flagged threshold 0.1

Chris: hypotheses: (1) PTQ packing/layout makes KV indices collide for long contexts, (2) tokenizer ID remap between quant build and runtime, (3) new kernel ordering in packed-kv-v2.
Lin: I instrumented KV idx sequence. reproducer shows duplicate offsets when stride != 1. The PTQ pipeline changed PACKED_KV_STRIDE to 2 in v2 build (old builds used 1). That looks suspicious.

Aneesha: so the packed-kv stride changed during quant build. Any change log for the quant toolchain?
Sara: I pulled the quant job diffs: commit 9f3b added optimization to "packedkvv2" enabling stride=2 for memory layout. The change landed in the PTQ recipe that produced v2.
Chris: OK that's a smoking gun candidate. Why would stride=2 cause early eos/repetition?
Lin: Packing with stride=2 shifts KV offsets, and our runtime's packed-kv decoder assumed contiguous stride=1 for the model geometry. When offsets don't align we sometimes read stale cache slots -> token mismatch + repeated generation -> early termination heuristics hit stopseq.
Aneesha: reproduction steps: locally build model with PACKED_KV_STRIDE=2 and run the same randprompt_suite_v3, yields the same drop. revert to stride=1 -> metrics return to baseline.

EvalBot: [attached failure sample from nightly] Prompt: "Explain black holes" -> v2 output: "A black hole is a region..." then repeats and returns early. (artifact)

Chris: immediate mitigation: rollback rwxd-3b-int8-ptq-v2 to v1 in hosted catalog and disable auto-promote for PTQ pipeline until we validate packing layout. I'll open a quick SR to run rollback.
Aneesha: going to push a block in model registry: set tag prevent_auto_promote=true for any model produced by PTQ pipeline commit range 9f3b..HEAD.
Sara: action item for infra: add a gating rule in the PTQ CI that runs a tiny context-continuity check (5 random prompts, check for early-eos rate < 0.1) before a build can be promoted to hosted.
Lin: for longer term: runtime should accept flexible stride in packed-kv decoding or fail-fast at load time. I'll draft a patch to decode based on stored layout metadata. Also add an assert when model metadata stride != runtime-compiled-default.
Chris: canary plan: re-run PTQ with stride=1 candidate build and deploy to dedicated-canary-3 (5% traffic) + run randprompt_suite_v3 every 15m for 24h. If drop < 0.05 we'll promote. If not, block and investigate further.
Aneesha: I've filed two tickets: ML-504 (revert PTQ default stride change & reproduce), INF-782 (runtime support for packed-kv stride metadata). Assigning ML-504 -> Lin, INF-782 -> Chris. Target MR by EOD tomorrow for the revert.
Sara: I'll add the CI gating rule and short eval in the PTQ workflow (PR opened: github.com/redwood/ptq/actions#321).

Chris: short-term rollout commands (ops):
```
# rollback model in registry
POST /internal/models/rollback
{"model":"rwxd-3b-int8-ptq-v2","to":"rwxd-3b-int8-ptq-v1","reason":"context-continuity regression nightly"}
```
Aneesha: done - rollback request submitted to deploy-bot. :white_check_mark:
Lin: local reproducer + debug logs attached to ML-504. I'll start the runtime patch tomorrow morning.
EvalBot: [automated] alert posted to eng-ml: "context_continuity_regression: rwxd-3b-int8-ptq-v2" at 2590012345

Chris: follow-ups: 1) patch runtime to read packed-kv stride metadata (INF-782) 2) add PTQ CI gating + canary eval (Sara) 3) add post-quant nightly context continuity tests (Aneesha) 4) expand model metadata validation to include "packed_kv_stride" (release infra).
Aneesha: thanks everyone. keeping this thread for logs/actions. ping me if you need quick access to the failing canary logs.
Sara: :thumbsup:
